issues.detail: The Greek 'η πεπληρωμενη' (the completed/fulfilled) is a participle/adjective describing the 'joy' (χαρα). The Vietnamese 'được trọn vẹn' translates this as a passive verb phrase ('to be fulfilled/completed'), changing the nature of the phrase from a description of the state of their joy to an action/purpose of the writing. In Greek, they are writing because their joy *is* already fulfilled; in Vietnamese, it sounds like they are writing *so that* their joy will become fulfilled.
